risk_reason and risk_severity are evidence hints from Cosmo memory when their source attributes are agent_memory_payload; validate them before treating the text as authoritative.
detections.runbook: Review the coordination-risk pattern recorded for the affected session and remediate the underlying risky coordination. Treat risk_reason and risk_severity as agent-written evidence hints when their source is agent_memory_payload, verify resolved memory facts against session and runtime evidence, and resolve the finding through the reviewed finding workflow rather than Cosmo memory alone.
detections.auditor_guidance: Review the normalized source-state snapshot and the provider evidence behind the flagged configuration to confirm the control state for the assessment period.
detections.risk_statement: Active agent-memory coordination risk may allow unsafe automated actions or data exposure.
detections.remediation_intent: Constrain the agent coordination path, validate guardrails, and retain agent evidence.

detections.name: Slack Privileged User Without MFA
detections.description: Detect active Slack workspace administrators or owners that can sign in without multi-factor authentication, leaving a privileged collaboration identity protected only by a password.
false_positives: Break-glass admin identities that authenticate through enterprise SSO with MFA enforced upstream and are risk-accepted in Slack.
detections.runbook: Confirm whether the privileged Slack identity should retain admin or owner access; if so, require two-factor authentication (or enforce SSO/MFA at the workspace), otherwise remove the elevated role.
detections.auditor_guidance: Review the normalized source-state snapshot and the provider evidence behind the flagged configuration to confirm the control state for the assessment period.
detections.risk_statement: Privileged collaboration accounts without enforced MFA weaken authentication assurance.
detections.remediation_intent: Enforce MFA for the privileged users, validate enrollment, and retain workspace evidence.

detections.name: Tailscale Tailnet Device Approval Disabled
detections.description: Detect Tailscale tailnets whose device approval is currently disabled, allowing new devices to join the tailnet without administrator review.
false_positives: Tailnets that intentionally rely on tag/ACL-based authorization instead of manual device approval.
detections.runbook: Confirm whether device approval should be enforced for this tailnet; if so, enable device approval so new devices require administrator review before joining.
detections.auditor_guidance: Review the normalized source-state snapshot and the provider evidence behind the flagged configuration to confirm the control state for the assessment period.
detections.risk_statement: Disabled device approval may allow unmanaged devices onto the private network.
detections.remediation_intent: Re-enable device approval, review enrolled devices, and retain tailnet evidence.

detections.name: Trivy Active Unresolved Image Vulnerability
detections.description: Detect container images with an active, unresolved high or critical Trivy vulnerability that has not been remediated or VEX-suppressed.
false_positives: Vulnerability suppressed by an accepted VEX not_affected statement or already remediated by a newer image build.
detections.runbook: Confirm the vulnerable package is present in the running image; upgrade to the fixed version or apply an accepted VEX statement, then rescan to clear the finding.
detections.auditor_guidance: Review the correlated graph path and each joined entity (identity, resource, control, and sensitivity marker), confirm the relationship is current, and validate the supporting evidence before relying on this detection.
detections.risk_statement: Active container-image vulnerabilities may be exploitable in deployed workloads.
detections.remediation_intent: Patch or rebuild the affected image, validate the fix, and retain scan evidence.

detections.name: Trusted Endpoint Active Trust-Gate Failure
detections.description: Detect Trusted Endpoint agents whose latest trust-gate decision denies a gated action, indicating the workstation currently fails the endpoint posture/trust checks required to perform the action until its posture is remediated.
false_positives: A trust-gate denial issued during an approved maintenance window or risk-accepted exception that has not yet been reflected as an allow decision.
detections.runbook: Inspect the agent's failing endpoint posture/trust checks, remediate the underlying gap, and confirm the next trust-gate decision for the action allows it.
detections.auditor_guidance: Review the normalized source-state snapshot and the provider evidence behind the flagged configuration to confirm the control state for the assessment period.
detections.risk_statement: An active trust-gate failure may allow non-compliant workstations to access protected resources.
detections.remediation_intent: Restore the endpoint trust posture, validate the gate, and retain device-trust evidence.

detections.name: VulnView Actionable External Finding
detections.description: Detect open VulnView external attack-surface findings that require AppSec triage.
false_positives: Finding is a duplicate, asset is intentionally exposed with compensating controls, or scanner severity was manually downgraded after validation.
detections.runbook: Validate exploitability and asset ownership, link duplicate external findings, patch or mitigate the exposed service, and document accepted risk.
detections.auditor_guidance: Review the normalized source-state snapshot and the provider evidence behind the flagged configuration to confirm the control state for the assessment period.
detections.risk_statement: An actionable external finding indicates an internet-exposed weakness that may be exploitable.
detections.remediation_intent: Remediate or remove the exposed surface, validate closure, and retain external-scan evidence.

detections.name: VulnView External Asset Concentrated Signal
detections.description: Aggregate VulnView graph evidence to prioritize external assets with medium-or-higher or repeated attack-surface signals.
false_positives: External asset is intentionally exposed and covered by compensating controls.
Multiple scanner signals represent duplicates for the same vulnerability instance.
detections.runbook: Prioritize the external asset owner, validate the highest severity evidence, deduplicate repeated findings, and remediate or accept the aggregate risk.
detections.auditor_guidance: Review the correlated graph path and each joined entity (identity, resource, control, and sensitivity marker), confirm the relationship is current, and validate the supporting evidence before relying on this detection.
detections.risk_statement: An actionable external attack-surface finding may be exploitable from the public internet.
